card.name: Linking words in drug interaction headings
card.fires_on: Small linking words right after a drug-interaction subject, such as "That" or "to" in section headings like "Drugs That Prolong QT", or "may"/"will" or a comma before "increase plasma concentrations".

modes.label: Interaction headings
modes.description: The word "That" or "to" in a numbered section 7 heading about drugs that affect or are affected by the product.
modes.example: 7.3 Drugs<< That>> Prolong QT Interval ZYK

modes.label: Verb slot before increase
modes.description: A comma or modal verb after a list of interacting drugs, just before "increase plasma concentrations".
modes.example: Concomitant use of SCEMBLIX<< may>> increase the plasma concentration of BCRP

card.plain: It marks the point in a drug-interaction statement where the text is about to say what effect one drug has on another.
